messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-04-22, the search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2026-06-09, the Dune team observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- The catalog service still relies on the resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2026-02-10, the Boreal team observed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- On 2025-12-18, the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team observed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- The feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, most of them identical, as of 2025-09-02. [valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
    earlier: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-01-14 to 2025-08-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
